lines.zh: 我扛着一块石头，慢慢走。
lines.en: I carry a stone and walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我的步子很笨，脚背朝外。
lines.en: My steps are clumsy, toes turned out.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草被踩平。
lines.en: The grass flattens where I walk.
I grunt twice as I walk.

lines.zh: 瓜哥跨过树干，肚子先过去。
lines.en: Grug steps over the log, belly first.
I shuffle a stretch toward you.
I drag my feet as if thinking.
I shift the stone to my other shoulder.

lines.zh: 我走两步，停下来看看天。
lines.en: I take two steps and stop to look at the sky.

lines.zh: 我朝林子里去，不赶时间。
lines.en: I head into the trees with no hurry.
I wobble past.
I stop and scratch my head.
I kick a stick out of the way.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看手里的东西。
lines.en: I walk while looking at what is in my hand.
I crunch across the dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转过身，接着走。
lines.en: I turn slowly and walk on.

lines.zh: 瓜哥走两步，回头确认你在。
lines.en: Grug takes two steps and checks you are still there.

lines.zh: 我朝有果子的树那边去。
lines.en: I head for the tree with fruit.
I squat and tap the ground with a stone.
I am thinking, very hard.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西转了转。
lines.en: I turn the thing in my hand over.
I look up as a bird flies past.
My brow stays furrowed.
I scratch my back; it feels good.
I sit and scuff my feet.
I stare at a hole in the ground.
I set the stone down slowly.
I open my mouth and yawn.
I am counting my fingers.
I sit and do nothing.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听林子里的响。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the sounds in the wood.
I snap a twig in two.
I have wisdom to share; listen.
I rub the dirt off my hands.
Grug has wisdom. He publishes it.

lines.zh: 我这彩蛋，还会说两句智慧。
lines.en: An easter egg that offers the odd wisdom.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，瓜哥想尝一口。
lines.en: Grug wants a taste of that.
I look down at you, very seriously.
Do not take my stone.
I raise my chin as if sizing you up.
Are you wise? I am.
I nod slowly.

lines.zh: 再近一步，瓜哥就蹭你身上。
lines.en: One step closer and Grug will rub against you.
I point at you and cannot find words.
Your bones do not look hard.
I am wondering whether to tell you to go.
I cover the spot that was hit.
I frown and step back.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的石头差点掉了。
lines.en: That almost made me drop my stone.

lines.zh: 瓜哥的瓜皮被敲了一下。
lines.en: Someone knocked Grug's rind.
I rub my shoulder slowly.
I hold still and take two breaths.
You hit harder than I expected.
I wave a hand to say stop.

lines.zh: 瓜哥躲到瓜叶底下，不吭声。
lines.en: Grug hides under a melon leaf, silent.
I look at the wound and think about it.

lines.zh: 你手里有果子，我看到了。
lines.en: You have fruit; I see it.
Could I have half of that?
Grug shuffles over, heavy of foot.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我够不着，腿也短。
lines.en: You hold the food high; I cannot reach, my legs are short.
I have a stone, but nothing to eat.
I smell something sweet, very strong.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，我就拿。
lines.en: Set it on the ground and I will take it.
I hold out my hand, palm open.
I stare at your hand, absorbed.

lines.zh: 瓜哥闻到了，甜的就跟你走。
lines.en: Grug smells it; for something sweet, Grug follows.
That dried meat looks familiar.

lines.zh: 我朝你伸着手，一直等着。
lines.en: I hold out my hand and keep waiting.
You set the basket down; good.
I will not snatch; I wait for you to give.
Your thing smells like food.

lines.zh: 你手里那点碎屑，也别浪费。
lines.en: Those crumbs in your hand; do not waste them.
You bump me and I catch you.
I am too heavy; you bounce off.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的脚，赶紧让开。
lines.en: I step on your foot and quickly move.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我手里的石头掉了。
lines.en: We collide and my stone falls.

lines.zh: 瓜哥一屁股坐进泥里，凉快。
lines.en: Grug plops into the mud. Nice and cool.

lines.zh: 我抬手把你挡开，很客气。
lines.en: I put out a hand to stop you, politely.
At the impact I grunt.
I hold you and get up.

lines.zh: 瓜哥的肚子一顶，你让开了。
lines.en: One push of Grug's belly and you move.

lines.zh: 我们分开，我拍了拍身上。
lines.en: We part and I brush myself off.
I have not thought about that.
I have not finished moving my stones.
I frown, not understanding.
I wave a hand and walk aside.
I need to think about that.
I scratch my head, uncertain.
You speak too fast.
I sit and do not respond.
I point at my stone.
I stand slowly and walk off.
Grug bends down. Very slowly.
I pick up the stone and weigh it.
This is good; I will take it.
I lift the stone, and drop it again.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰上的皮袋。
lines.en: I stuff it into the pouch at my waist.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看了看，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick it up, look at it, and sniff it.
I pick it up and hug it.

lines.zh: 这块亮石头，瓜哥替你收着。
lines.en: Grug will keep this shiny rock for you.
I pick it up and hand it to you.
I hold it and compare its size.
Grug has chosen that piece.
You are carrying something good.
I look your way a while.
One glance is enough for Grug to choose.
Grug is about to share wisdom.

lines.zh: 瓜哥看中了，就是瓜哥的。
lines.en: If Grug likes it, it is Grug's.

lines.zh: 那边有动静，瓜哥去看看。
lines.en: Something moves over there. Grug will look.
I remember where you stood.
The target is that shiny one.
I hoot at you.
I keep watching your hands.
You step back; I follow two steps.

lines.zh: 我在你想要走的那条路上站着。
lines.en: I stand where you meant to go.
I lower my head to look at you.
I have a few words to say.
Bring it out; I am waiting.
I keep watching your bag.
I sit beside you and stay.
You turn away, and I turn too.

lines.zh: 我扛着一块石头，慢慢凑过来。
lines.en: Carrying a stone, I shuffle closer.

lines.zh: 我推你一下，没别的意思。
lines.en: I push you, no other meaning.
I tap you with the stone.
My palm is heavy on that one.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子往回带。
lines.en: I take your sleeve and pull back.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，力气不小。
lines.en: I raise a hand to block, and it is strong.
You fall back two steps and I stand blank.
That was not really hitting.

lines.zh: 瓜哥整个压上去，你动不了。
lines.en: Grug flops down; you cannot move.
I charge in, solidly.
My shoulder led that one.
I straighten up from behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我先哼了一声，你才看见我。
lines.en: I grunt first, and then you see me.

lines.zh: 我扛着石头出现在坡上。
lines.en: I appear on the slope carrying a stone.
My crouching shadow grows.

lines.zh: 瓜哥从瓜藤里滚了出来。
lines.en: Grug rolls out of the melon vines.
I walk slowly this way.

lines.zh: 地上的土先被踩出了声。
lines.en: Footsteps sound in the dirt first.

lines.zh: 我站在林子边缘，看着你。
lines.en: I stand at the edge of the trees, watching you.

lines.zh: 瓜哥举起手，算是问好了。
lines.en: Grug raises a hand in greeting.
I land in a pile of leaves.

lines.zh: 我把石头放在脚边，坐下了。
lines.en: I set the stone down and sit.

lines.zh: 瓜哥清清嗓子，准备发表智慧。
lines.en: Grug clears his throat to share wisdom.

lines.zh: 火燎到手臂，我拍了好几下。
lines.en: Fire catches my arm and I swat at it.
I fall down the slope and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水一口口灌进来，我乱扑。
lines.en: Water pours in and I thrash.
The blast tips me over.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我腿上，我拔不掉。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my leg and I cannot pull it.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我手里的石头掉了。
lines.en: A spell hits and my stone falls.

lines.zh: 好久没吃东西，肚子一直响。
lines.en: Long without food, and my stomach will not stop.
Lightning strikes and I duck down.

lines.zh: 虚空拉我，我抓着石头不放。
lines.en: The void pulls and I cling to the stone.
